The context your digital campaign can't create

Japanese luxury consumers don't make purchase decisions impulsively. They consider. They encounter a brand across multiple contexts, in environments they trust, over time. Japan transit advertising is one of those trusted contexts - and it's the one most international luxury brands have never accessed programmatically.

According to NRI/jeki research, train and station advertisements are the most positively received media in Japan - more favourably received than TV commercials, Vogue Japan spreads, or Nikkei newspaper ads. For a luxury brand, the context in which your message appears matters as much as the message itself. Transit earns that context.
